title: Center for Undergraduate Research and Academic Engagement (Florida State University) (applications open)
lab_or_program: Center for Undergraduate Research and Academic Engagement
description:
FSU's Center for Undergraduate Research and Academic Engagement (CRE) is the campus hub connecting undergraduates of every major to research mentors, funding, and structured programs. It houses the UROP research program, IDEA Grants funding, the annual Undergraduate Research Symposium, and guidance on how to find a faculty mentor and get started in research and creative activity.

From the program page: Welcome to the CRE! The CRE is leading a growing movement to involve FSU students in the highest levels of academic engagement, helping students take advantage of the very best a major research university like FSU has to offer. title: UROP: Undergraduate Research Opportunity Program (Florida State University)
description: The Undergraduate Research Opportunity Program (UROP) pairs first- and second-year FSU students with faculty and graduate-student mentors on ongoing research and creative projects across every discipline. Participants join a year-long colloquium, work in a mentor's lab or project, and present at the spring Undergraduate Research Symposium — a structured entry point into research for students new to it.

title: IDEA Grants (FSU Center for Undergraduate Research and Academic Engagement)
description: FSU IDEA Grants provide competitive funding to support student-initiated research, creative, and entrepreneurial projects.
